caveats: Region = 60x60 grid cells (lat 59.94-61.12N, lon 18.70-19.88E on the 0.02-deg grid) inside the inclusive bounds. SST in kelvin as stored. 1956 of 3600 cells were sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days); land/missing cells are 0. Thresholds = hazen (Hyndman-Fan type 5) 90th percentile of the per-day-of-year pool of baseline days 1992-2002 with +/-5 calendar-day windows (pool dates 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05, 121 days each; Feb 29 values in the neighbour windows; day 60 = mean of days 59 and 61), then 31-day centred circular moving mean. Per-cell MHW = >=5 consecutive days with SST >= threshold, runs joined across 1-2 non-hot gaps; regional event = maximal run of days with >=1 sea cell in an MHW. One regional event covers the entire target period.
